messages:
jess-support: FYI incoming escalation from ACME — they claimed AWS Accelerator credits via Marketplace but console shows 0 balance. Customer says they received AWS confirmation email. Account: acct-acme-9876. AWS order id: 9876543210-aws.

jess-support: pasted the confirmation email from AWS, includes entitlement id ent-aws-77a3 and purchaser_account_id 111222333444. They say the grant was part of the "Startup Accelerator" promo.

maria-billing: got it. Can you run the internal credits lookup and paste the response? need entitlement id + marketplace order id. Also please confirm whether any tokens were used after the claim. :eyes:

jess-support: running curl against billing service: 
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $BILLING_API_TOKEN" "https://billing.internal/api/v1/credits?account=acct-acme-9876"
```
Response:
```
{"account":"acct-acme-9876","credits_total":0,"credits_available":0,"entitlements":[]}
```

maria-billing: thanks — not showing any entitlement linked. Could be entitlement ingestion missed mapping. Assigning to eng to sanity-check partner metadata.

sam-platform: I remember a recent change to marketplace ingestion where we started normalizing payer vs purchaser fields. Quick check: does the entitlement store partner_metadata.purchaser_account_id or partner_metadata.payer_account_id? If the AWS order used purchaser_account_id but our ingest wrote payer_account_id we might not link to the account.

lee-partner-ops: looked up order 9876543210-aws — AWS shows purchaser_account_id=111222333444 and buyer_relationship=SUBACCOUNT (accelerator flow). Our ingestion expects "aws_main_account_id" for mapping, so subaccount grants could be missed. This is likely the cause.

sam-platform: confirm. I see an ingestion log for ent-aws-77a3 with partner_metadata: {"aws_account":"111222333444","partner_purchaser":null,"aws_payer":"555666777888"} — we were matching on aws_payer. Because accelerator grants were given to a subaccount (111222333444) and not the payer, entitlement wasn't attached.

jess-support: ok — what's the ops plan? customer is blocked from using credits. They haven't run production calls yet.

maria-billing: immediate plan: I can issue a manual ledger grant for acct-acme-9876 for the same credit amount while eng backfills the mapping. Please confirm amount from AWS confirmation.

jess-support: AWS confirmation lists 50,000 token credits (labelled as 50k-generation-units).

maria-billing: I'll create manual grant and reference a ticket. Creating ledger entry now — internal ticket BILL-4021. Manual grant applied: 50k tokens, source=manual-accelerator-migration, note="temporary fix for marketplace subaccount mapping". Posting transaction id tx-acc-20260317-5543.

billing-bot: Automated notice: Ledger entry tx-acc-20260317-5543 applied to acct-acme-9876 — amount: 50000 gen units, created_by: maria-billing, ticket: BILL-4021.

jess-support: told customer to check console. Customer confirms: "I can see 50,000 credits in account, thank you." They did a small test call and used ~120 tokens successfully.

lee-partner-ops: root fix: shipping a small ingestion change to match purchaser_account_id and fall back to payer. PR: internal/infra/entitlement/patches#234 — will backfill entitlements where partner_metadata.purchaser exists but not linked. Running a backfill script now (estimate 10-20m for this single order, longer in bulk). SQL snippet I'm running: 
```
UPDATE entitlements e
SET account_id = m.account_id
FROM partner_metadata m
WHERE e.partner_entitlement_id = m.partner_entitlement_id
  AND e.account_id IS NULL
  AND m.purchaser_account_id IS NOT NULL;
```

sam-platform: will monitor ingestion queue and confirm when backfill completed. Also adding an alert to catch future mismatches.

maria-billing: leaving ticket BILL-4021 open until backfill completes. I reconciled ledger and AWS confirmation email. No charge discrepancy.

jess-support: customer confirms everything working now. Closing loop with them. Thanks all :white_check_mark: 

lee-partner-ops: follow-up: I'll post PR link and deployment ETA in BILL-4021. Once backfill runs we'll re-check other accelerator orders for same pattern. :+1:

maria-billing: marking as actioned on our side. If you see other accounts, ping me and I'll queue manual fixes.

jess-support: closing thread — please keep BILL-4021 updated.
